name: Blooming Hearts!
source:
During the day, Rowan is an ordinary high school student and kind of a loner. At night, she fights the Aphids as a magical girl called Carnation. One day her companion Aster turns her crush Penelope into a magical girl. Rowan must teach Penelope how to be a magical girl. Will they defeat the enemy and find love? Play to find out! 

Bloom my Heart!

[From [url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/blooming-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
